review_response_tasks.stem: The paint is wet. Keep your hands off it. Don't ____ it.
review_response_tasks.rationale: A：keep your hands off明确不要碰，对应touch。；B：看不等于手碰，不是这条提醒所禁动作。；C：从旁走过不等于手碰，不合明确的hands off。

review_response_tasks.stem: —Is this a storybook? —____ It has stories in it.
review_response_tasks.rationale: A：后句说明有故事，与否定storybook冲突。；B：后句说明故事内容，支持肯定。；C：后文提供明确故事依据，不合此处不知道。

review_response_tasks.rationale: A：those books为复数，不能用It is。；B：题面inside不是on表面。；C：inside对应in，books复数对应They are。
